selection: Fixed mechanism diagnostic, not a new font search; retains all eight predetermined cases, six blocks and five trials per process. No exclusion, retry or optional stopping.
estimator: Median of five trial phase means within each process; for the reported 65-frame sequence, sum each trial phase mean times its frame count before taking the process median. Average paired block differences for master-final, master-no_retention and no_retention-final. No confidence interval or significance claim from this exploratory six-block ablation.
interpretation: no_retention is the final implementation with exactly one self.insert_scaled_outline(key) call removed. It retains classification, run-scaler reuse, lookup/key creation, native scratch, budget enforcement and rerasterization. Differences versus final describe this retention implementation including admission/storage/hit behavior; they do not isolate hint VM cost alone. Feature settings match production benchmark defaults.
image_evidence: No new no-retention application pixel proof is collected. Earlier image evidence covers original Rye/Vollkorn controls and localized CJK campaigns; the exploratory English CJK-font cohort has no application pixel proof. Source-only insertion removal and original workload/source identities are recorded. No GUI or GPU preflight.
